visual_reference.reference_title: Modern mobile fresh market and gourmet store UI

layout.concept: Clean gourmet market interface with zero philosophy clutter: hero with floating fresh coffee visual, high-contrast market cards with weight/portion chips, crisp inline SVG icons, and a dedicated seller POS terminal protected by a modern auth lock card.
layout.alignment: Left-aligned editorial typography on wide desktop grid, with centered floating hero focal elements and balanced multi-column product card distribution.

principles: Stripping away redundant philosophy sections transforms Kantin Boash into a hyper-efficient market app. Removing emojis from dashboard controls elevates the merchant portal into a high-utility POS terminal powered by crisp vector graphics, while student ordering benefits from tactile market chips and immediate cart feedback.

orchestrated_moment.trigger: Single continuous floating animation on the hero beverage visual, with static crisp state on all UI controls and portal widgets
orchestrated_moment.justification: Capping motion strictly at the hero maintains the chilled, fresh beverage atmosphere without distracting users during critical menu selection and order management.

token_overrides.border_radius: rounded-3xl (24px) for cards and modals, rounded-full for pills, rounded-2xl for dashboard tiles
token_overrides.spacing: Generous py-16 to py-20 section gutters, 4/8dp spatial grid inside cards
token_overrides.palette: Crisp white cards, rich espresso #1A1A1A, market crimson #DC2626 accents, and custom SVG line icons replacing emojis
